7340.title: Retention batch validation repeatedly scans the thread catalog
7340.rootCauseOneLine: Per-group revalidation calls the full catalog pagination and selection helper again, yielding 1,616 full-list requests in the 7,600-thread fixture.
7340.proposedFix: Use fresh relationship-aware scoped validation without losing discovery of new hidden lifecycle dependents; the known-ID snapshot prototype was rejected by two safety tests.
7340.caveats: SDK-boundary reproduction, repeated by the same agent in a clean trusted worktree; no production latency or SQL profiler. Test and exact outputs are inline; no PR because the evaluated optimization failed safety checks.
